Used/adapted for Living Empires: The Broken Accord, 19 September 2026.
Changes made for selected game derivatives: spatial extraction of building
regions from the combined source mesh; ground/pivot and scale normalization;
mesh combination; solid source material colors converted to an opaque URP
palette material; addition of gameplay selection colliders. Building-role
mapping and gameplay behavior are additions by the Living Empires project.
The original AllAssets.fbx file is retained unchanged. No endorsement by
iedalton or Sketchfab is implied.
